settings.whisper_info_desc: Small is fast and accurate enough for most videos. For many special terms, loud background sound or strong accents, pick Medium or Large-v3.

settings.test_first: Test the connection first to see the available models.
settings.ai_mode_title: Automatic AI with an API key
settings.ai_mode_desc: By default you copy the instructions to ChatGPT or Gemini, then paste the answer back. With an API key, the app picks the moments itself and skips that step.
settings.pexels_desc: The Pexels key is used to find footage that matches what the clip is about. It works with or without an AI API key.
settings.face_engine_help: Used when framing is set to Follow the face. Try Precise if the face is often missed.
settings.downloader_title: Download a video without making clips
settings.downloader_subtitle: Downloads the whole video from the link in the shape you choose. Subtitles are added only when switched on. The result appears in History.
settings.downloader_running: A video is being processed. Wait until it finishes before downloading another one.
settings.help_step_video: Paste a video link or choose a video file. Pick the clip shape, then press Start.
settings.help_step_prepare: The app gets the video and writes down everything that is said. Wait until it is done.
settings.help_step_choose: Copy the instructions, paste them into ChatGPT or Gemini, then paste the answer back.
settings.help_step_clips: The app cuts the chosen moments into clips. Download or share them from the result, or open them again in History.

free.a: Yes. You only use ChatGPT or Gemini in your browser to pick the moments.
free.a_keys: An API key is only for automatic AI, and the AI provider bills you for it.

sources.a: A YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram link, or a video file from this device. In the Colab version you can also pick a video from Google Drive.

youtube.q: A YouTube video will not download. What now?
youtube.a: YouTube sometimes refuses downloads until you sign in. Open Settings, YouTube, and follow the cookies steps there. Then try again.

moments.q: The AI picked the wrong moments. What now?
moments.a: Make clips again from the same video and ask the AI for other moments.
moments.a_keys: With an API key you can also open the project in History and choose Pick moments again with AI.

slow.q: Why does it take so long?
slow.a: The video is processed on this computer, or on Google Colab for the cloud version. Long videos and computers without a graphics card (GPU) take longer. The progress screen shows the step that is running.

change.q: Can I change the shape or subtitles after the clips are made?
change.a: Yes. On a clip in the result, open the three-dot menu and choose Change subtitles or look. For all clips at once, open the project in History and choose Make all clips again.

custom_ai.q: Can I use an AI that runs on my own computer, such as Ollama?
custom_ai.a: Yes, when Use an API key is on. In Advanced, choose the Custom (OpenAI Compatible) provider, then fill in the server address and model name. Leave the API key empty if the server does not ask for one.

mac.q: macOS: the app opens, but the status stays Disconnected.
mac.a: macOS blocks the part of the app that processes video because the app is not yet approved by Apple. Open Terminal, run xattr -cr "/Applications/Auto Clipper.app", then open Auto Clipper again. Once per install is enough.

cookies.title: YouTube cookies
cookies.intro: If YouTube asks for verification before a video can be downloaded, upload a cookies.txt file here. The file holds proof of login from your browser.
cookies.warn_title: Use a spare account, not your main one
cookies.warn_body: YouTube can restrict an account whose cookies are used for downloading. Use a separate Google account kept for this.
cookies.guide_title: How to get the cookies.txt file
cookies.step1: In your computer's browser, install the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension.
cookies.step2: Open youtube.com and log in with the spare account.
cookies.step3: On that YouTube tab, click the extension's icon, choose Export, then upload the file here.
cookies.status_load_failed: The cookies status could not be loaded. Make sure the app is still connected, then try again.
cookies.status_none: No cookies file is stored yet.
cookies.status_ok: The cookies file is stored and still valid.
cookies.logged_out_title: This file is not from a logged-in account
cookies.logged_out_body: These cookies were exported while the browser was not logged in to YouTube, so YouTube will still ask for verification. Log in to YouTube with the spare account, then export and upload again.
cookies.upload_failed: The cookies file could not be uploaded. Try again.
cookies.delete_failed: The cookies file could not be deleted. Try again.
cookies.delete_confirm: Videos that ask for verification cannot be downloaded until you upload a new file.
cookies.privacy: The file is stored on this computer and is only used when downloading videos.
cookies.privacy_cloud: The file is stored in the app's data folder (on Google Colab: your Google Drive, folder AutoClipperData/cookies) and is only used when downloading videos.
